cues.text: A cluttered dorm room, seen from high in one corner. Clothes, magazines and rubbish cover the floor, a guitar leans against the shelves and posters cover the walls.
Mitsuru walks in and picks her way through the mess, looking around. A police officer follows her in.
Junpei walks in and stops short at the sight of them.
Officer Kurosawa walks out past Junpei.
Mitsuru walks out past Junpei, and the door closes behind her, leaving him alone in his room.
